title: MV I need time related tileset s

posts.author: fatalstary
posts.body:
Hello people of rpg maker. First post here.
I just made a time master npc and desperately need some time related tiles, like gears pendulums or clocks, but i can't find any for free. I have in mind the KR Legendary palaces - chimera tileset dlc, but I'm trying to find a free alternative.

posts.author: ElvenNeko
posts.body:

Hey!  To get the most out of the following rtp edits and tilesets  use them for parallax mapping. If you still like to use them with the editor you might need to rearrange some of it.  Terms to use:  You must own a legal version of RPG Maker MV to use these edits and the credit goes to Kadokawa...
